description: Turn one source — a URL, pasted text or markdown, or an RSS item — into channel-native variants such as an X thread, LinkedIn post or carousel, Instagram caption or reel script, newsletter, or YouTube description. Fetches the URL, extracts the core message, writes each variant with AI, and saves source and variants. Returns each saved variant with its id. Nothing is scheduled or published. Counts against the monthly ContentRipple allowance.

formats.description: Which variants to write. Omit for all of them.

raw_content.description: Source text or markdown, up to 20,000 characters (required for text/docforge).

source_type.description: url: fetch source_url. text or docforge: use raw_content (pasted text or markdown). rss: pass the item's URL as source_url.

name: repurpose_content
